proves.claim: clause 2: a merged move on a board with 250 held items, each scanning children lookup costing 15 ms, ends its hold within 2.0 s.

store.io-board-write-lock.merged-slow-st.why: The slowest merged hold step is liftSettledHolds, whose children lookup scanned every item row once per held item; a hold over 2.0 s stalls every other board writer.

proves.claim: clause 2: creating the item_parent_status index on 12,750 items of about 600 characters of text answers the children lookup from the index alone and reports its build time.

store.io-board-write-lock.parent-index-b.why: The index is created under the write lock on a board's first open, so its build time is a hold.
